docs.summary: The scene's depth target, when the feature reads the scene.
How far each opaque surface moved across the screen since last frame, in uv, when the feature reads the scene and declares it in SceneReads.
The scene's octahedral world normals, when the feature reads the scene and declares them in SceneReads.
The scene's roughness and metallic, when the feature reads the scene and declares them in SceneReads.
The colour the feature reads, when it reads or writes colour.
A texture the feature declared.
A buffer the feature declared or read from a frame feature.
The view's first layer as shaders read it this frame, jittered when the view jitters.
Whether the view drew last frame, so motion and history from then mean something.
The frame's time as the host gave it.
Whether a feature before this one in the view encoded the colour for display, as tonemappers do.
The renderer's noise: blue noise in red, white noise in green, voronoi in blue, 256 square, mipmapped.
The direction the world's sun shines, its chosen sun or else its brightest directional light, or null without one.
The view's layers as shaders read them this frame, jittered when the view jitters.

docs.summary: Draws a fullscreen program over a texture the feature declared, Temporary or History, the colour it reads bound as Graphite_Source, with any properties given. Clear first clears it to transparent black, for programs that discard. Shared draws once over a texture of one layer, for state a layered view's layers share.
